title: Tuesday brain dump + errands
content:
Quick dump for the day (rapid-fire, not polished)

Morning log:
- woke 07:05, strong coffee at 07:20, email triage 07:30-07:50 (cleared inbox except long threads)
- energy: 7/10, focus windows look good today

Top priorities (today):
1) Finish PR #452 (runtime batching tweak) - add unit test for KV cache edge case, update PR description with perf numbers. TODO: run perf bench locally after change (use bench-script-v2).
2) Sync with Maya on model onboarding docs (notes + checklist) - send draft by EOD so she can review before Thursday customer call.
3) Customer A POC: export trimmed logs and send to Sarah (CS) — include sample traffic profile and latency summary.

Meetings / blocks:
- 09:30–10:00: 1:1 w/ Riley (quick agenda: career goals, blockers on docs)
- 10:15–11:00: design review (serve runtime batching) — bring perf graphs, explain fallback policy tradeoffs
- 14:00–15:00: onboarding sync w/ Maya + CS (prep: share model-run checklist)
- 16:30–17:00: quick catch w/ Ethan on dev-ex SDK rollout plan

Errands / personal to-dos:
- pick up prescription (Walgreens on 7th) after 17:30
- groceries: almond milk, spinach, bananas, eggs (quick run)
- order USB-C -> Ethernet dongle (amazon prime, this week)
- dentist confirm appointment for April (call Tues morning)
- submit March conference expense (scan receipt + submit in Expensify)

Notes to self (small actionable lines):
- during 10:15 review, mute notifications and only take notes — one follow-up doc afterwards
- try using venv:bench2 to reproduce bench numbers, log with bench-run-2026-03-20.txt
- remember to bump test timeout for long sequence tests in ci (flaky occasionally)
- quick code todo: add header guard for X-User-ID in request middleware (if missing -> 401)

Ideas / brainstorm (unpolished):
- micro CLI: "redwood-latency-check" that pings endpoints in list of regions and reports 95th/99th pct by model variant. Use as part of pre-deploy smoke check.
- small UX experiment: show model variant and cost estimate in console before route creation (helps teams pick cheaper fallbacks)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- ENG-2431: need final decision on canary rollout percentage. Is 10% too small given traffic shape? Ask SRE for guidance.
- confirm whether dedicated pool supports mixed-quantization (ask infra)
- get legal sign-off on PII fields in customer logs export (liaise w/ legal@redwood)

Micro-retro (end of day quick):
- what went well: quick progress on PR, synced with Riley, clarified docs action items
- what was a pain: flaky bench on my laptop — schedule time with infra to debug reproducibility
- tomorrow: finish PR merge + ship docs to Maya, follow up on canary percentage, prepare demo for Customer A

Random notes / links to paste later:
- PR #452: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/452
- bench script: scripts/bench/run_local.sh 
- Jira: ENG-2431 (canary rollout policy)

Tiny reminders (one-liners):
- turn on do-not-disturb 10:15–11:15
- water the ficus (house plant)
- bring portable battery to office tomorrow

End of dump — keep this as a transient scratchpad, clean up tomorrow into a proper tasks doc and move follow-ups into Jira/Confluence where appropriate.
